name: Make
summary: Visual no-code platform for building automations and AI agent workflows across apps.
description: Make is a no-code automation platform where users build workflows, called scenarios, on a visual canvas that connects thousands of apps. It also supports AI agents that run inside those workflows. Usage is measured in credits. A free plan includes 1,000 credits per month, and paid plans add more credits and features; enterprise plans include 24/7 support.

howToUse.title: Open Make
howToUse.description: Open Make and start on the free plan of this no-code automation platform.

howToUse.title: Build a scenario on the canvas
howToUse.description: On the visual canvas, build a workflow called a scenario. The canvas connects thousands of apps from the integration library.

howToUse.title: Put an agent inside the workflow
howToUse.description: Add an AI agent so it runs inside the scenario, then watch usage, which is measured in credits.

howToUse.title: Raise the credit allowance
howToUse.description: The free plan includes 1,000 credits per month. Paid plans add more credits, and enterprise plans include 24/7 support.
